articles.title_en: Labour Market Screening and the Design of Social Insurance: An Equilibrium Analysis of the Labour Market for the Disabled
articles.title_cn: 劳动力市场筛选与社会保险设计：残疾人劳动力市场的均衡分析
articles.abstract_en: This article studies how firms’ screening incentives in the labour market affect the optimal design of social insurance programs and quantitatively assesses the U.S. disability policies accounting for firms’ screening of the disabled. We develop an equilibrium search model where workers with different productivities have heterogeneous preferences over non-wage benefits and firms cannot offer an employment contract that explicitly depends on worker types. In this environment, firms may use contracts to screen out a certain type of workers, distorting employment rates and contracts in equilibrium. Therefore, the optimal structure of social insurance policies depends on firms’ screening incentives. We extend and structurally estimate this framework to quantitatively understand the inefficiencies arising from firms’ incentives to screen out disabled workers and examine the optimal joint design of disability insurance (DI) and various forms of firm subsidies. We find that hiring subsidies mitigate screening distortions; at the same time, they interact with DI by reducing the labour supply disincentives it generates. The optimal policy structure leads to a considerable welfare gain by simultaneously making firm subsidies and DI benefits more generous.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了企业在劳动力市场上的筛选激励如何影响社会保险计划的优化设计，并定量评估了美国残疾政策中企业对残疾人筛选的影响。我们开发了一个均衡搜索模型，其中不同生产率的工人对非工资福利有不同的偏好，并且公司不能提供明确取决于工人类型的雇佣合同。在这种环境下，企业可能会利用合同来筛选某种类型的工人，从而扭曲就业率和合同的均衡状态。因此，社会保险政策的最优结构取决于企业的筛选激励。我们对这个框架进行了扩展和结构性估计，以定量理解企业筛选残疾工人的激励措施所带来的低效率，并研究残疾保险（DI）和各种形式的企业补贴的最佳联合设计。我们发现，招聘补贴可以缓解筛选扭曲；与此同时，它们通过减少直接投资产生的劳动力供应抑制因素来与直接投资互动。最优的政策结构通过同时使企业补贴和直接投资福利更加慷慨而带来可观的福利收益。

articles.title_en: Optimal Allocation via Waitlists: Simplicity Through Information Design
articles.title_cn: 通过候补名单进行优化分配：通过信息设计实现简单化
articles.abstract_en: We study non-monetary markets where objects that arrive over time are allocated to unit-demand agents with private types, such as in the allocation of public housing or deceased-donor organs. An agent’s value for an object is supermodular in her type and the object quality, and her payoff is her value minus her waiting cost. The social planner’s objective is a weighted sum of allocative efficiency (i.e. the sum of values) and welfare (i.e. the sum of payoffs). We identify optimal mechanisms in the class of direct-revelation mechanisms. When the social planner can design the information disclosed to the agents about the objects, the optimal mechanism has a simple implementation: a first-come first-served waitlist with deferrals. In this implementation, the object qualities are partitioned into intervals; only the interval containing the object quality is disclosed to agents. When the planner places a higher weight on welfare, optimal disclosure policies become coarser.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究非货币市场，其中随着时间的推移到达的物体被分配给具有私人类型的单位需求代理，例如公共住房或已故捐赠器官的分配。代理对对象的价值在她的类型和对象质量上是超模块化的，她的回报是她的价值减去她的等待成本。社会规划者的目标是配置效率（即价值之和）和福利（即收益之和）的加权和。我们在直接揭示机制类别中确定了最佳机制。当社会规划者可以设计向代理披露有关对象的信息时，最佳机制有一个简单的实现：一个第一-来第一服务的带有延期的候补名单。在此实现中，对象质量被划分为区间；仅向代理公开包含对象质量的区间。当规划者对福利给予更高的重视时，最优披露政策就会变得更加粗糙。

articles.abstract_en: How should the government respond to automation? We study this question in a heterogeneous agent model that takes worker displacement seriously. We recognize that displaced workers face two frictions in practice: reallocation is slow and borrowing is limited. We analyze a second best problem where the government can tax automation but lacks redistributive tools to fully alleviate borrowing frictions. The equilibrium is (constrained) inefficient and automation is excessive. Firms do not internalize that automation depresses the income of automated workers early on during the transition, precisely when they become borrowing constrained. The government finds it optimal to slow down automation on efficiency grounds, even when it does not value equity. Quantitatively, the optimal speed of automation is considerably lower than at the laissez-faire. The optimal policy improves efficiency and delivers meaningful welfare gains.
articles.abstract_cn: 政府应如何应对自动化？我们在一个认真考虑工人流失的异构代理模型中研究这个问题。我们认识到，失业工人在实践中面临二摩擦：重新分配缓慢且借贷有限。我们分析了一个最佳问题，即政府可以对自动化征税，但缺乏再分配工具来充分缓解借贷摩擦。这种平衡是（受限的）低效且自动化过度。企业并没有意识到，在转型初期，即当他们的借贷受到限制时，自动化会压低自动化工人的收入。政府认为，即使政府并不重视公平，但出于效率的考虑，放慢自动化速度是最佳选择。从数量上来说，自动化的最佳速度比自由放任的速度要低得多。最优政策可以提高效率并带来有意义的福利收益。

articles.title_en: Private Sector Provision as an “Escape Valve”: The Mexico Diabetes Experiment
articles.title_cn: 私营部门提供的“逃生阀”：墨西哥糖尿病实验
articles.abstract_en: Public health systems are dominant in much of the world but often face fiscal constraints that lead to rationing of care. As a result, private sector healthcare providers could in theory beneficially supplement public systems, but evaluating the benefits of private alternatives has been challenging. We evaluate a private supplement to the free public health system for one of the world’s deadliest health problems, diabetes. We estimate enormous impacts of the private supplement, increasing the share of those treated who are under control by 69%. This effect arises through both improved treatment compliance and health behavior. We find diabetes complications fall in the short run, and that the net costs of this intervention are one-third of the gross costs. The returns to private care do not appear to reflect more productive delivery but rather more attachment to medical care, offering lessons for improving the public system.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共卫生系统在世界大部分地区占主导地位，但经常面临导致护理配给的财政限制。因此，理论上，私营部门的医疗保健提供者可以有益地补充公共系统，但评估私营替代方案的好处一直具有挑战性。我们评估了对免费公共卫生系统的私人补充，以解决一世界上最致命的健康问题——糖尿病。我们估计私人补助的巨大影响，增加了受69%控制的治疗者的比例。这种效果是通过改善治疗依从性和健康行为而产生的。我们发现糖尿病并发症在短期内会下降，并且这种干预措施的净成本是总成本的一-第三。私人医疗保健的回报似乎并不反映生产效率更高，而是反映了人们对医疗保健的更多依恋，为改善公共系统提供了经验教训。

articles.title_en: Adaptive Estimation and Uniform Confidence Bands for Nonparametric Structural Functions and Elasticities
articles.title_cn: 非参数结构函数和弹性的自适应估计和均匀置信带
articles.abstract_en: We introduce two data-driven procedures for optimal estimation and inference in nonparametric models using instrumental variables. The first is a data-driven choice of sieve dimension for a popular class of sieve two-stage least-squares estimators. When implemented with this choice, estimators of both the structural function h0 and its derivatives (such as elasticities) converge at the fastest possible (i.e. minimax) rates in sup-norm. The second is for constructing uniform confidence bands (UCBs) for h0 and its derivatives. Our UCBs guarantee coverage over a generic class of data-generating processes and contract at the minimax rate, possibly up to a logarithmic factor. As such, our UCBs are asymptotically more efficient than UCBs based on the usual approach of undersmoothing. As an application, we estimate the elasticity of the intensive margin of firm exports in a monopolistic competition model of international trade. Simulations illustrate the good performance of our procedures in empirically calibrated designs. Our results provide evidence against common parameterizations of the distribution of unobserved firm heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入二数据驱动程序，使用工具变量在非参数模型中进行最佳估计和推理。 第一 是一种数据驱动的筛维选择，适用于流行的筛 二 级最小二乘估计器。当使用这种选择实现时，结构函数 h0 及其导数（例如弹性）的估计量以超范数中最快的可能（即极小极大）速率收敛。 第二 用于构建 h0 及其导数的统一置信带 (UCB)。我们的 UCB 保证覆盖一类通用的数据生成过程，并以最小最大速率（可能高达对数因子）进行合同。因此，我们的 UCB 渐近比基于通常的欠平滑方法的 UCB 更有效。作为一个应用，我们估计了国际贸易垄断竞争模型中企业出口集约边际的弹性。模拟说明了我们的程序在经验校准设计中的良好性能。我们的结果提供了反对未观察到的企业异质性分布的常见参数化的证据。

articles.title_en: Information Spillovers and Sovereign Debt: Theory Meets the Eurozone Crisis
articles.title_cn: 信息溢出和主权债务：理论与欧元区危机的结合
articles.abstract_en: We develop a theory of information spillovers in sovereign bond markets in which investors can learn about default risk before trading in primary and secondary markets. If primary markets are structured as multi-unit discriminatory-price auctions, an endogenous winner’s curse leads to strategic complementarities in information acquisition. Shocks to default risk in one country may trigger crisis episodes with widespread information acquisition, sharp increases in the level and volatility of yields in risky countries, low and stable yields in safe countries, market segmentation, and arbitrage profits between primary and secondary markets. These predictions are consistent with the dynamics of auction informativeness during the Eurozone Sovereign Debt Crisis, which we measure using the reaction of secondary market yields to primary market yields.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了主权债券市场的信息溢出理论，投资者可以在一级和二级市场交易之前了解违约风险。如果一级市场的结构是多单位歧视性价格拍卖，那么内生的赢家诅咒就会导致信息获取方面的战略互补。 一国家违约风险冲击可能引发危机事件，信息获取广泛，风险国家收益率水平和波动性急剧上升，安全国家收益率低而稳定，市场分割，一级市场和二级市场套利利润增加。这些预测与欧元区主权债务危机期间拍卖信息的动态一致，我们使用二级市场收益率对一级市场收益率的反应来衡量。

articles.title_en: Partially Linear Models under Data Combination
articles.title_cn: 数据组合下的部分线性模型
articles.abstract_en: We study partially linear models when the outcome of interest and some of the covariates are observed in two different datasets that cannot be linked. This type of data combination problem arises very frequently in empirical microeconomics. Using recent tools from optimal transport theory, we derive a constructive characterization of the sharp identified set. We then build on this result and develop a novel inference method that exploits the specific geometric properties of the identified set. Our method exhibits good performances in finite samples, while remaining very tractable. We apply our approach to study intergenerational income mobility over the period 1850–1930 in the U.S. Our method allows us to relax the exclusion restrictions used in earlier work, while delivering confidence regions that are informative.
articles.abstract_cn: 当在二无法链接的不同数据集中观察到感兴趣的结果和一些协变量时，我们研究部分线性模型。这类数据组合问题在实证微观经济学中经常出现。使用最优传输理论中的最新工具，我们得出了尖锐识别集的建设性表征。然后，我们在此结果的基础上开发了一种新颖的推理方法，该方法利用已识别集的特定几何属性。我们的方法在有限样本中表现出良好的性能，同时保持非常易于处理。我们应用我们的方法来研究美国1850-1930期间的代际收入流动性。我们的方法使我们能够放宽早期工作中使用的排除限制，同时提供信息丰富的置信区域。

articles.title_en: Too Domestic to Fail: Liquidity Provision and National Champions
articles.title_cn: 过于国内而不能倒闭：流动性供应和国家冠军
articles.abstract_en: Authorities’ support policies shape the location and continuation of industrial and banking activity on their soil. Firms’ locus of activity depends on their prospect of receiving financial assistance in distress and therefore on factors such as countries’ relative resilience. We predict that global firms are global in life and national in death; and that they become less global when competition is more intense, times are turbulent, and international risk sharing (say, through swap lines) weak. We analyse the competitive benefits of industrial and banking policies as well as their limitations, such as currency appreciation.
articles.abstract_cn: 当局的支持政策决定了工业和银行活动在其土地上的位置和持续性。企业的活动地点取决于它们在困境中获得财政援助的前景，因此也取决于国家的相对弹性等因素。我们预测，跨国公司生时是全球性的，死时是全国性的；当竞争更加激烈、时代动荡、国际风险分担（例如通过互换额度）薄弱时，它们的全球化程度就会降低。我们分析工业和银行政策的竞争优势及其局限性，例如货币升值。

articles.abstract_en: To analyse climate change mitigation strategies, economists rely on simplified climate models—so-called climate emulators—that provide a realistic quantitative link between CO2 emissions and global warming at low computational costs. In this paper, we propose a generic and transparent calibration and evaluation strategy for these climate emulators that are based on freely and easily accessible state-of-the-art benchmark data from climate sciences. We demonstrate that the appropriate choice of the free model parameters can be of key relevance for the predicted social cost of carbon. The key idea we put forward is to calibrate the simplified climate models to benchmark data from comprehensive global climate models that took part in the coupled model intercomparison project, phase 5 (CMIP5). In particular, we propose to use four different test cases that are considered pivotal in the climate science literature: two highly idealized tests to separately calibrate and evaluate the carbon cycle and temperature response, an idealized test to quantify the transient climate response, and a final test to evaluate the performance for scenarios close to those arising from economic models, and that include exogenous forcing. As a concrete example, we re-calibrate the climate part of the widely used DICE-2016, fathoming the CMIP5 uncertainty range of model responses: the multi-model mean as well as extreme, but still permissible climate sensitivities and carbon cycle responses. We demonstrate that the functional form of the climate emulator of the DICE-2016 model is fit for purpose, despite its simplicity, but its carbon cycle and temperature equations are miscalibrated, leading to the conclusion that one may want to be skeptical about predictions derived from DICE-2016. We examine the importance of the calibration for the social cost of carbon in the context of a partial equilibrium setting where interest rates are exogenous, as well as the simple general equilibrium setting from DICE-2016. We find that the model uncertainty from different consistent calibrations of the climate system can change the social cost of carbon by a factor of 4 if one assumes a quadratic damage function. When calibrated to the multi-model mean, our model predicts similar values for the social cost of carbon as the original DICE-2016, but with a strongly reduced sensitivity to the discount rate and about 1 degree less long-term warming. The social cost of carbon in DICE-2016 is oversensitive to the discount rate, leading to extreme comparative statics responses to changes in preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了分析气候变化缓解策略，经济学家依靠简化的气候模型（所谓的气候模拟器）以较低的计算成本提供二氧化碳排放与全球变暖之间的现实定量联系。在本文中，我们为这些气候模拟器提出了一种通用且透明的校准和评估策略，该策略基于可免费且轻松获取的来自气候科学的最先进基准数据。我们证明，自由模型参数的适当选择对于预测的碳社会成本至关重要。我们提出的关键想法是校准简化的气候模型，以参与耦合模型比对项目阶段5（CMIP5）的综合全球气候模型的基准数据。特别是，我们建议使用四在气候科学文献中被认为至关重要的不同测试用例：二高度理想化的测试来分别校准和评估碳循环和温度响应，理想化的测试来量化瞬态气候响应，以及最终的测试来评估与经济模型产生的场景相近的性能，其中包括外生强迫。作为一个具体的例子，我们重新校准了广泛使用的 DICE-2016 的气候部分，了解模型响应的 CMIP5 不确定性范围：多模型平均值以及极端但仍然允许的气候敏感性和碳循环响应。我们证明，DICE-2016 模型的气候模拟器的功能形式尽管简单，但符合目的，但其碳循环和温度方程校准错误，导致 一 可能对 DICE-2016 得出的预测持怀疑态度。我们研究了在利率为外生的部分均衡设置以及 DICE-2016 的简单一般均衡设置的背景下校准碳社会成本的重要性。我们发现，如果 一 假设二次损害函数，则气候系统不同一致校准的模型不确定性可以将碳的社会成本改变 4 倍。当校准到多模型均值时，我们的模型预测的碳社会成本值与原始 DICE-2016 相似，但对贴现率的敏感性大大降低，并且长期变暖程度降低约 1 度。 DICE-2016中碳的社会成本对贴现率过于敏感，导致对偏好变化的极端比较静态反应。

articles.title_en: Good Politicians: Experimental Evidence on Motivations for Political Candidacy and Government Performance
articles.title_cn: 优秀的政治家：政治候选人动机和政府绩效的实验证据
articles.abstract_en: How can we motivate good politicians—those that will carry out policy that is responsive to citizens’ preferences—to enter politics? In a field experiment in Pakistan, we vary how political office is portrayed to ordinary citizens. Emphasizing prosocial motives for holding political office instead of personal returns—such as the ability to help others versus enhancing one’s own respect and status—raises the likelihood that individuals run for office and that voters elect them. A year later, the treatment improves the alignment of policy with citizens’ preferences. These effects emerge only when treatments are randomly delivered in a public setting. Taken together, the results demonstrate that how politics is perceived shapes who decides to run for office, who is elected, as well the policies that democracies deliver.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们如何才能激励优秀的政治家——那些会执行响应公民偏好的政策的人——进入政坛？在巴基斯坦的一项实地实验中，我们改变了向普通公民描绘政治职位的方式。强调担任政治职务的亲社会动机而不是个人回报——例如帮助他人的能力与提高一自己的尊重和地位——增加了个人竞选公职和选民选举他们的可能性。一年后，这种待遇改善了政策与公民偏好的一致性。仅当在公共环境中随机进行治疗时，这些效果才会出现。总而言之，结果表明，人们对政治的看法影响着谁决定竞选公职、谁当选，以及民主国家实施的政策。

articles.title_en: International Comovement in the Global Production Network
articles.title_cn: 全球生产网络中的国际联动
articles.abstract_en: This article provides a general framework to study the role of production networks in international GDP comovement. We first derive an additive decomposition of bilateral GDP comovement into components capturing shock transmission and shock correlation. We quantify this decomposition in a parsimonious multi-country, multi-sector dynamic network propagation model, using data for the G7 countries over the period 1978–2007. Our main finding is that while the network transmission of shocks is quantitatively important, it accounts for a minority of observed comovement under the estimated range of structural elasticities. Contemporaneous responses to correlated shocks in the production network are more successful at generating comovement than intertemporal propagation through capital accumulation. Extensions with multiple shocks, nominal rigidities, and international financial integration leave our main result unchanged. A combination of TFP and labour supply shocks is quantitatively successful at reproducing the observed international business cycle.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文提供了研究生产网络在国际 GDP 联动中的作用的总体框架。我们第一将双边GDP联动分解为捕捉冲击传递和冲击相关性的组成部分。我们使用七国集团国家在1978-2007期间的数据，在一个简约的多国家、多部门动态网络传播模型中量化这种分解。我们的主要发现是，虽然冲击的网络传播在数量上很重要，但它占结构弹性估计范围内观察到的联动的一小部分。对生产网络中相关冲击的同期反应比通过资本积累进行的跨期传播更能成功地产生联动。多重冲击、名义刚性和国际金融一体化的扩展使我们的主要结果保持不变。全要素生产率和劳动力供应冲击的结合在数量上成功地再现了观察到的国际商业周期。

articles.title_en: Transhumant Pastoralism, Climate Change, and Conflict in Africa
articles.title_cn: 非洲的游牧放牧、气候变化和冲突
articles.abstract_en: We consider the effects of climate change on seasonally migrant populations that herd livestock—i.e. transhumant pastoralists—in Africa. Traditionally, transhumant pastoralists benefit from a cooperative relationship with sedentary agriculturalists whereby arable land is used for crop farming in the wet season and animal grazing in the dry season. Rainfall scarcity can disrupt this arrangement by inducing pastoral groups to migrate to agricultural lands before the harvest, causing conflict to emerge. We examine this hypothesis by combining ethnographic information on the traditional locations of transhumant pastoralists and sedentary agriculturalists with high-resolution data on the location and timing of rainfall and violent conflict events in Africa from 1989 to 2018. We find that reduced rainfall in the territory of transhumant pastoralists leads to conflict in neighbouring areas. Consistent with the proposed mechanism, the conflicts are concentrated in agricultural areas; they occur during the wet season and not the dry season; and they are due to rainfall’s impact on plant biomass growth. Since pastoralists tend to be Muslim and agriculturalists Christian, this mechanism accounts for a sizable proportion of the rapid rise in religious conflict observed in recent decades. Regarding policy responses, we find that development aid projects tend not to mitigate the effects that we document. By contrast, the effects are reduced when transhumant pastoralists have greater power in national government, suggesting that more equal political representation is conducive to peace.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考虑气候变化对放牧牲畜的季节性移民人口的影响，即放牧牲畜的人口。迁徙的牧民——在非洲。传统上，游牧牧民受益于与定居农民的合作关系，即耕地在雨季用于农作物种植，在旱季用于放牧动物。降雨稀缺可能会导致牧民在收获前迁移到农田，从而破坏这种安排，从而导致冲突的出现。我们通过将游牧牧民和定居农民的传统位置的人种学信息与1989至2018非洲降雨和暴力冲突事件的位置和时间的高分辨率数据相结合来检验这一假设。我们发现，游牧牧民境内降雨量减少导致邻近地区发生冲突。与拟议的机制一致，冲突集中在农业地区；它们发生在雨季而不是旱季；这是由于降雨对植物生物量生长的影响。由于牧民往往是穆斯林，而农耕者往往是基督徒，这种机制在近几十年来观察到的宗教冲突迅速上升中占了相当大的比例。关于政策反应，我们发现发展援助项目往往不会减轻我们记录的影响。相比之下，当游牧牧民在国家政府中拥有更大权力时，其影响就会减弱，这表明更平等的政治代表权有利于和平。

articles.title_en: Reservation Raises: The Aggregate Labour Supply Curve at the Extensive Margin
articles.title_cn: 保留率提高：广义边际的总劳动力供给曲线
articles.abstract_en: We measure desired labour supply at the extensive (employment) margin in two representative surveys of the U.S. and German populations. We elicit reservation raises: the percent wage change that renders a given individual indifferent between employment and nonemployment. It is equal to her reservation wage divided by her actual, or potential, wage. The reservation raise distribution is the nonparametric aggregate labour supply curve. Locally, the curve exhibits large short-run elasticities above 3, consistent with business cycle evidence. For larger upward shifts, arc elasticities shrink towards 0.5, consistent with quasi-experimental evidence from tax holidays. Existing models fail to match this nonconstant, asymmetric curve.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在二对美国和德国人口的代表性调查中衡量了广泛（就业）边际的理想劳动力供给。我们引出保留加薪：使特定个人在就业和非就业之间变得无所谓的工资变化百分比。它等于她的保留工资除以她的实际或潜在工资。保留加薪分布是非参数总劳动力供给曲线。就局部而言，该曲线表现出高于3的较大短期弹性，这与经济周期证据一致。对于较大的向上偏移，弧弹性收缩至 0.5，与免税期的准实验证据一致。现有模型无法匹配这条非常量、不对称的曲线。

articles.title_cn: 使用昂贵的信息进行稳健的实施
articles.abstract_en: We construct mechanisms that can robustly implement any desired social choice function when (1) agents may incur a cost to learn the state of the world, (2) with small probability, agents’ preferences can be arbitrarily different from some baseline known to the mechanism designer, and (3) the mechanism designer does not know agents’ beliefs and higher-order beliefs about one another’s preferences. The mechanisms we propose have a natural interpretation and do not require the mechanism designer to be able to verify the state ex post. We also establish impossibility results for stronger notions of robust implementation.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建的机制可以稳健地实现任何期望的社会选择函数，当（1）代理人可能会产生学习世界状态的成本，（2）小概率，代理人的偏好可以与机制设计者已知的某些基线任意不同，以及（3）机制设计者不知道代理人的信念和关于一另一个人的偏好的高阶信念。我们提出的机制有一个自然的解释，不需要机制设计者能够事后验证状态。我们还建立了不可能的结果，以增强强有力的实施理念。

articles.title_en: The Causal Impact of Socio-Emotional Skills Training on Educational Success
articles.title_cn: 社会情感技能培训对教育成功的因果影响
articles.abstract_en: We study the long-term effects of a randomized intervention targeting children's socio-emotional skills. The classroom-based intervention for primary school children has positive impacts that persist for over a decade. Treated children become more likely to complete academic high school and enrol in university. Two mechanisms drive these results. Treated children show fewer attention deficit/hyperactivity disorder symptoms: they are less impulsive and less disruptive. They also attain higher grades, but they do not score higher on standardized tests. The long-term effects on educational attainment thus appear to be driven by changes in socio-emotional skills rather than cognitive skills.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究针对儿童社会情感技能的随机干预的长期影响。针对小学生的课堂干预产生了持续十多年的积极影响。接受治疗的儿童更有可能完成高中学业并进入大学。 二机制驱动这些结果。接受治疗的儿童表现出较少的注意力缺陷/多动障碍症状：他们较少冲动且较少破坏性。他们也取得了更高的成绩，但他们在标准化考试中得分并不高。因此，对教育程度的长期影响似乎是由社会情感技能的变化而不是认知技能的变化驱动的。

articles.title_en: Surviving Competition: Neighbourhood Shops versus Convenience Chains
articles.title_cn: 在竞争中生存：社区小店与连锁便利店
articles.abstract_en: Hundreds of millions of microenterprises in emerging economies face increased competition from the entry and expansion of large firms that offer similar products. This paper examines the impacts of the opening of chain-run convenience stores on one of the world’s most ubiquitous microenterprises: owner-operated shops. To address endogeneity in time and location of chains’ opening, I pair two-way fixed effects with a novel instrument that shifts the profitability of chains but not of shops at the neighbourhood level. Expanding the number of chain outlets from zero to the neighbourhood average of 6.7 stores reduces the number of shops by 15%, a decline driven not by increased shop exits but by decreased shop entries. Shops retain their sales of fresh products and keep 96% of their customers, but customers visit shops less frequently and spend less on packaged goods. Surviving shops leverage competitive advantages stemming from being owner operated, such as lower agency costs, cultivating relationships with neighbours, and offering customers informal credit. The welfare gains of convenience chains replacing shops increase with household income; the poorest households experience a welfare loss.
articles.abstract_cn: 数以亿计的新兴经济体微型企业，正面临提供相似产品的大型企业进入和扩张所带来的更激烈竞争。本文研究连锁便利店开业对世界上最常见的微型企业之一——个体经营小店——的影响。为解决连锁店开业时间和地点的内生性问题，作者将双向固定效应与一种新工具变量结合起来，该工具在社区层面上影响连锁店的盈利能力，但不影响小店的盈利能力。将连锁门店数量从零扩张到社区平均水平 6.7 家，会使小店数量减少15%，这一下降并非由小店退出增加所致，而是由小店新进入减少所致。小店仍保住了鲜活商品销售，并留住了96%的顾客，但顾客到店频率更低，在包装商品上的支出也更少。存活下来的小店利用了个体经营带来的竞争优势，例如更低的代理成本、与邻里的关系网络以及向顾客提供非正式赊账。连锁便利店替代小店带来的福利增益会随家庭收入上升而增加；最贫困家庭则会遭受福利损失。

articles.title_en: Estimating Equilibrium in Health Insurance Exchanges: Price Competition and Subsidy Design under the ACA
articles.title_cn: 估计健康保险交易所的均衡：ACA 下的价格竞争和补贴设计
articles.abstract_en: Regulations to design private yet publicly sponsored health insurance markets are increasingly adopted in many OECD countries. Here I combine data and economic theory to analyse the interaction between insurers’ competition and the design of premium subsidies in determining equilibrium outcomes. My empirical model includes adverse selection, rich heterogeneity in preferences for vertically and horizontally differentiated plans and accommodates alternative assumptions on pricing conduct. In the context of the Affordable Care Act in the U.S., I estimate the joint distribution of preferences and expected cost using Californian administrative records on 3.4 million plan choices between 2014 and 2017, combined with plan and survey data on medical claims. An empirical horse race between conduct assumptions favours oligopoly pricing over perfect competition. Considering alternative subsidy designs shows that, in equilibrium, shifting subsidy generosity toward the “young invincibles” would lower premiums for all enrolees while increasing enrolment and profits.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多经合组织国家越来越多地采用设计私人但公共资助的健康保险市场的法规。在这里，我结合数据和经济理论来分析保险公司竞争与保费补贴设计之间的相互作用，以确定均衡结果。我的实证模型包括逆向选择、对纵向和横向差异化计划的偏好的丰富异质性，并适应定价行为的替代假设。在美国《平价医疗法案》的背景下，我使用加州关于 3.4 和 2014 之间 2017 百万 计划选择的行政记录，结合医疗索赔的计划和调查数据，估计了偏好和预期成本的联合分布。行为假设之间的实证赛马有利于寡头垄断定价而不是完全竞争。考虑替代补贴设计表明，在均衡状态下，将补贴慷慨转向“年轻无敌”将降低所有参保者的保费，同时增加入学率和利润。
